jobs.description:
Are you passionate about keeping production equipment running at peak performance through structured maintenance strategies and continuous improvement-and are you located in Denmark? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.

As our new Maintenance Engineer, you will be planning, coordinating, and optimizing preventive maintenance and TPM activities across our Electronics Factory, working closely with production teams and technicians to ensure stable, efficient operations. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

What you will be doing

As a key part of the Manufacturing Maintenance team, you'll create impact by Driving equipment reliability and production uptime through data-driven maintenance strategies and structured problem-solving that directly supports our manufacturing excellence..

Your main responsibilities include:

• Plan, coordinate, and develop preventive maintenance plans and TPM activities, optimizing intervals based on condition-based maintenance principles

• Identify and implement improvements to equipment, processes, and maintenance methods using data analysis and KPI follow-up

• Manage maintenance budgets and collaborate with external service providers and internal stakeholders

• Maintain technical documentation, SAP master data, and ensure compliance with applicable standards

• Contribute to competence development and knowledge sharing among technicians and colleagues

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you are a structured and analytical engineering professional with hands-on maintenance experience in manufacturing, motivated by driving continuous improvements through technical expertise and cross-functional collaboration. We would also imagine that you have:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field

• 1-2+ years of experience with maintenance in a manufacturing environment

• Ability to read and understand technical drawings and documentation

• Knowledge of SAP or another ERP system for maintenance management

It is a plus if you also:

• Experience with TPM, Lean, and structured problem-solving methodologies

• Familiarity with condition-based maintenance and spare parts strategy development

• Experience leading processes or projects within Manufacturing Engineering

Why you will love working here

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.

• Access to on-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds.

Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com

About Grundfos

Grundfos is one of the world’s leading water technology companies with more than 19.000 employees in 60+ countries all over the world. Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

Hartmann Packaging, a global leader in sustainable packaging solutions headquartered in Copenhagen, is currently seeking an experienced and results-oriented Commercial Finance Business Partner, Europe.

With a turnover of DKK 2 billion, operations across numerous European countries, and approximately 1,500 employees, Europe represents Hartmann’s largest and most strategically important region.

About the Role

We are looking for a commercially driven and analytically strong finance professional to support our growth agenda by increasing financial transparency, optimizing pricing models, and driving revenue assurance. This role is a key part of Hartmann’s finance transformation, where we are building a proactive finance function that enables data-driven decision-making and supports strategic execution across the business.

As Commercial Finance Business Partner, Europe, you will play a central role in developing pricing strategies, improving profitability, managing contracts, and delivering actionable financial insights. You will work closely with senior leadership and commercial teams to strengthen the financial foundation for commercial excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Commercial Excellence & Pricing Strategy

• Develop and implement dynamic pricing models to enhance revenue and competitiveness

• Support the sales organization with financial insights to improve customer profitability

• Conduct in-depth market and competitor analysis to guide strategic pricing decisions

Revenue Assurance & Profitability Analysis

• Ensure accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting

• Identify and mitigate risks related to revenue leakage and margin erosion

• Conduct detailed profitability analyses across products, customers, and markets

• Analyze cost structures and recommend initiatives to improve financial performance

Contract Management, Negotiation & Risk Mitigation

• Support contract negotiations with financial analysis and recommendations

• Advise on discount and bonus models for key accounts

• Oversee contract lifecycle management and ensure compliance

• Collaborate with Accounts Receivable to manage credit terms and collections

• Implement strong governance frameworks to safeguard revenue streams

Business Intelligence & Market Analysis

• Leverage tools such as PowerBI and Excel to analyze financial data and trends

• Provide timely, data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making

• Monitor market developments and business performance to identify risks and opportunities

Qualifications & Experience

• Master’s degree or Graduate Diploma in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field

• Proven experience as a Commercial Finance Business Partner or in a similar role supporting sales and revenue optimization

• Strong commercial acumen and ability to work cross-functionally with business units

• Solid understanding of ERP systems and Business Intelligence tools (e.g., PowerBI, Excel)

Skills & Competencies

• Deep understanding of pricing, profitability, and revenue optimization

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills

• Experience with financial risk assessment, contract management, and credit control

• Ability to interpret complex financial data and translate it into clear business actions

• Proactive mindset with the ability to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

We are looking for an extroverted, energetic, and proactive individual with a strong commercial mindset and the ability to make a tangible impact on business performance.

Why Join Hartmann?

This is a unique opportunity to become part of a forward-looking finance team and play a key role in shaping the commercial direction of Europe’s leading region in Hartmann. You will work closely with senior leaders, contribute to the transformation of our finance function, and have high visibility across the business.

Hartmann offers a competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and a workplace that values sustainability, innovation, and people development.

Contact & Application

For more information about the position, please contact Brian Ranvits from European Search Company at +45 2048 0548.

If this sounds like your next career move, please apply via link below.

About Hartmann Packaging

Founded in 1917, Hartmann is headquartered in Gentofte, Denmark.

Hartmann is the world’s leading manufacturer of moulded fibre egg packaging with approximately 2,800 employees divided into 3 regions Europe, North America & South America + APAC.

Hartmann sell egg and fruit packaging to producers, packing businesses and retail chains, all of which are increasingly turning to us to benefit from our expertise, both technically and in branding and selling their products. Our moulded fibre packaging is sold in markets all over the world with Europe, South America and North America as our key markets. We are a market leader in Europe and in South America and India, where our product portfolio also includes fruit packaging.  Hartmann is part of the THORNICO Group.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner for backup and recovery service
jobs.description:
Product Owner (Manager Role) for global backup and recovery service

Do you have hands-on experience owning or managing backup and disaster recovery services in an enterprise environment, including RPO, RTO and retention requirements?

For one of our clients, a large Danish company within the Life science & Pharma industry, we are seeking an experienced Product Owner for backup and recovery with leadership experience. You will become part of a dynamic and challenging environment characterized by high ambitions and a corresponding level of complexity. You will take part in shape the future of enterprise backup technology and safeguard the data that enables life-changing treatments to reach millions of patients.

Backup, and recovery

As Product Owner, you’ll lead and own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for the organization’s backup technology. You’ll take an active leading role and you’ll combine deep technical expertise in backup and cloud technologies with strong stakeholder management to ensure our service meets business continuity, compliance and operational objectives while driving continuous improvement and value delivery.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the IT Backup Service, aligned with business continuity, security and compliance goals

• Owning the product backlog by writing, prioritizing and refining user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (RTO, RPO, retention, encryption, etc.)

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery and continuous improvement

• Defining and monitoring KPIs for the backup service to drive performance and reliability

• Ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal backup policies, including data residency, retention, encryption and audit capability

• Managing incident response involvement for major backup/recovery incidents, leading post-incident reviews and implementing preventive measures

• Communicating roadmap, status, risks and outcomes to senior management and stakeholders in clear, executive-level language.

Your skills & qualifications

We’re looking for a Product Owner who can bridge technical depth with strategic vision, stakeholder engagement and leadership of the area.

You’ll bring with you:

• Expertise in people leadership

• Strong technical background in backup and recovery technologies, with solid understanding of RPO/RTO, retention schemes, backup architecture, snapshots, replication and restore workflows

• Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Technical Lead for infrastructure or platform services in an enterprise environment

• Demonstrated ability to translate technical detail into executive-level communication and vice versa, ensuring clarity across all organizational levels

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and build consensus across diverse teams

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Experience working within regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX) in enterprise IT environments is a plus.

Apply now

For additional information about the position, please contact:

• Brian Ranvits on +45 2048 0548

• Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 2080 1638

If you see yourself in the position, please submit your application using the apply button below.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once the right candidate is identified.

Do you thrive in a role where you are close to the pulse of the business and work directly with executive management? Are you able to ensure an efficient and structured workday while respecting all business priorities? If so, you now have a unique opportunity to bring your professionalism into play and act as a trusted Executive Assistant to the CEO and the rest of the executive team at Norican in Taastrup.

Your role and responsibilities

As an Executive Assistant, you will occupy a key role as the central focal point, setting the direction for management's administration and creating structure. Working within a dynamic team of executives, you will act as the primary point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders globally.

In this position, execution and discretion are priority areas and are seen as a crucial discipline where high quality is paramount. This means your day-to-day work will offer significant professional variety through a wide range of administrative and coordination tasks. In this role, you will act as a gatekeeper, create clarity, and ensure smooth daily operations for the executive management team

Your most important task is to ensure that executive management's visions are effectively supported. You will do this by:

• Managing and prioritizing the CEO's calendar according to the annual business wheel, with a focus on allocating time for strategic meetings and urgent matters

• Acting as the primary liaison and local ambassador, ensuring seamless communication between the executive management, and all internal and external stakeholders

• Planning and organizing meetings, gathering input, and managing logistics

• Handling global travel logistics for the executive team, including flights, hotels, transportation, visa applications, and travel expense reports

To succeed in the role

To succeed in this role, it is crucial that you can maintain oversight and act as a trusted partner to the executive management team. Your success will be measured by the CEO always being well-prepared, meetings being flawlessly organized, and your ability to intuitively anticipate needs before executive management asks. Therefore, you must be able to communicate clearly, exhibit exceptional discretion with confidential information, and handle stakeholders at all levels. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and remain resilient and calm even when deadlines approach and pressure rises.

We hope that you will bring:

• A minimum of 5–10 years of documented, successful experience as a PA/EA supporting C-level management

• A relevant educational background, such as a BA in Business Administration, or equivalent solid experience

• Excellent communication skills, fluent proficiency in English (written and spoken), and strong IT and MS Office capabilities

• Experience navigating complex global travel logistics and an understanding of cross-cultural differences

• A proactive, highly service-minded, and independent approach with a strong "can-do" attitude

Why you should join Norican?

In this role, you will play a crucial part in enabling the executive management team to succeed in driving Norican’s ambitious agenda and continued growth. You will be close to the heart of the business while becoming part of a professional, informal, and down-to-earth culture, where people work closely together, trust each other, and focus on making things happen. Professionally, you will benefit from a direct reporting line to the CEO and hold a central position that ensures the executive team’s continuous efficiency both locally and globally.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

Ready to learn more and ready to apply?

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. We will process your application confidentially, and it will only be shared with your prior consent. If you have any further questions about the position, feel free to contact our Recruitment Consultant on this role Mille Maegaard-Fast at +45 92 92 08 53.

About Norican

NORICAN. Shaping Industry.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

Can you deliver technology initiatives that create measurable operational value and enable business outcomes? At Orifarm, we are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Product Owner to help shape the digital solutions supporting our global Supply Chain operations

About the job

You will play a central role in bridging Supply Chain and Corporate IT, ensuring our solutions deliver value to the business while supporting operational excellence and future growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT colleagues, vendors, and partners, you will drive improvements, translate business needs into solutions, and help shape the future direction of our ERP landscape.

The role combines elements of product ownership, ERP expertise, demand management, business engagement and continuous improvement. You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, translate them into actionable priorities and ensure solutions are delivered and adopted successfully. As part of this, you will also contribute to a significant ERP transformation initiative, representing Supply Chain requirements and helping ensure continuity between current and future solutions.

Your key responsibilities:

• Own and manage the roadmap, backlog and priorities for Supply Chain-related ERP capabilities and supporting solutions

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain stakeholders to understand business goals, challenges and opportunities

• Translate business and operational requirements into scalable solution designs and delivery priorities

• Function as solution and system owner for relevant Supply Chain platforms and capabilities

• Collaborate with developers, architects, vendors and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of enhancements and projects

• Support incident resolution, governance activities and ongoing optimization efforts

• Contribute to our ERP transformation journey by supporting requirements validation, testing, business readiness and adoption activities

Succes in this role means:

• Supply Chain solutions remain stable, secure, compliant and continuously improving

• Business stakeholders experience IT as a trusted and value-adding partner

• Demand and improvement opportunities are translated into clear priorities and successful deliveries

• Operational excellence and long-term transformation objectives are balanced successfully

• New capabilities are supported by standardized, scalable and efficient solutions across Supply Chain

Who are you?

You enjoy working at the intersection of business and technology, and you understand how digital solutions can enable efficient and scalable Supply Chain operations. You move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational challenges, building strong relationships across both business and IT.

You are a pragmatic and proactive problem solver who can balance competing priorities, challenge existing ways of working constructively, take ownership of outcomes and focus on delivering real business value. Most importantly, you understand that technology is only successful when it is adopted and creates measurable outcomes for the business.

We imagine that you have:

• Experience from roles such as Solutions Lead, Product Owner, ERP Consultant, Functional Lead, Lead Business Analyst, Application Manager or similar

• A strong understanding of Supply Chain processes and the systems supporting them

• Experience working with enterprise ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, IFS, Infor or similar

• Experience managing roadmaps, backlogs and business demand

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience working across business and IT functions

• The ability to translate business requirements into scalable and practical solutions

• Fluent English skills, written and spoken

Who are we?

Group & Compliance Solutions is a central function within IT, responsible for delivering and evolving digital capabilities that support critical business processes across Orifarm. We work closely with functions throughout the organization, including Supply Chain, which is at the heart of Orifarm's business model. Supply Chain’s ability to source, repackage, and distribute pharmaceutical products reliably and compliantly across markets depends on effective processes, strong data foundations, and the right technology solutions, making our work an essential enabler of business success.

You will join a skilled and dedicated ERP team within Group & Compliance Solutions that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed. We offer an informal yet ambitious environment with a strong sense of team spirit, where learning from experience is encouraged and new perspectives are valued. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to influence both solutions and ways of working.

You will be reporting to the Director of Group & Compliance Solutions.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Key Account Manager – SITS I SecureDevice, Denmark

Location: Copenhagen (Hybrid)

Reports to: Sales Manager, SITS I SecureDevice Denmark

Company: SecureDevice – Part of the SITS Group

Scope: Denmark & Nordic Growth

About SITS I SecureDevice

SITS I SecureDevice is part of the SITS Group, headquartered in Switzerland and active across Northern Europe. We are one of Denmark’s leading cybersecurity solution providers, trusted by over 100 Danish customers across private and public sectors.

We operate across seven specialized practices, providing end-to-end services from advisory and architecture to managed security, detection & response, and compliance.

What truly sets us apart is our culture — a people-first mindset where trust, collaboration, and professional curiosity define how we work. At SITS I SecureDevice, we believe that great people create great business.

The Role

As Key Account Manager, you will play a central role in strengthening and expanding relationships with SITS I SecureDevice’s key customers. You’ll act as a trusted advisor who understands the customer’s business, identifies opportunities, and connects them with the right SITS expertise.

You will collaborate closely with our consultants, technical specialists, and leadership team to ensure customer satisfaction, long-term engagement, and mutual growth.

You will report directly to the Sales Manager, SITS SecureDevice Denmark, and work as part of a high-performing, people-focused commercial team driving growth in Denmark and across the Nordics.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and grow relationships with key customers across private and public sectors.

• Engage deeply with clients to understand their business and security needs, translating them into tailored SecureDevice solutions.

• Drive consultative sales across our seven cybersecurity practice areas in close collaboration with technical specialists and consultants.

• Identify and develop new opportunities within existing accounts.

• Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention through proactive engagement and consistent follow-up.

• Contribute to sales reporting, forecasting, and pipeline management, ensuring transparency and structure.

• Represent and strengthen SITS I SecureDevice’s people-first and trust-based culture in all customer interactions.

Your Profile

You are a relationship-driven professional with a passion for cybersecurity and a strong commercial mindset. You understand how to build trust, create value, and translate complex technical topics into clear business outcomes.

You likely bring:

• Experience in B2B account management or solution sales, preferably within cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, or managed services.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders.

• A solid understanding of cybersecurity principles such as threat management, compliance, or cloud security.

• A structured, proactive, and collaborative approach to your work.

• Fluency in Danish and English (spoken and written).

Why SecureDevice

• Be part of a people-first culture built on trust, collaboration, and professional growth.

• Work alongside some of Denmark’s most skilled cybersecurity experts.

• Manage relationships with over 100 active customers and contribute to our Nordic growth journey.

• Competitive compensation and career development opportunities within the SITS Group.

Ready to build trusted partnerships that make a difference in cybersecurity?

We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Scientist – Proteomics and Project Leadership (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about advancing proteomics and skilled at driving scientific projects from idea to execution? We're seeking a Scientist to join our R&D team in Odense. This is a 1-year maternity cover position with the potential to transition into a permanent role.

What we do

Evosep aims to improve quality of life and patient care by radically innovating protein based clinical diagnostics. Making sample preparation and separation before MS analysis 10 times faster and 100 times more robust will enable truly large cohort studies for biomarker validation and provide the foundation for precision medicine.

Key tasks and responsibilities

Scientific execution

• Develop and apply high-throughput proteomics workflows (sample preparation and LC‑MS)

• Ensure high-quality, reproducible data generation to support product development

• Evaluate experimental design and interpret complex datasets

• Stay current on emerging technologies and methodologies

Project management

• Drive end-to-end project execution from scope to delivery, ensuring timelines and milestones are met

• Define project scope, goals, and success criteria in alignment with stakeholders

• Coordinate cross-functional teams across R&D, Applications, and Commercial

• Translate scientific insights and market input into actionable project plans

• Identify risks, track progress, and ensure transparent communication to stakeholders

• Contribute to structured documentation and traceability (e.g. requirements, plans, deliverables) in line with internal processes

Qualifications

Your most important qualification is your personality! We care about hiring people who we believe can thrive and develop at Evosep. Our team is diverse, but a positive can-do attitude and the desire to be part of something bigger than yourself are common characteristics for the entire team. To be successful in this role, you should also ideally bring:

• An M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Analytical Sciences, Biochemistry or related fields.

• Hands-on experience developing and executing high-throughput proteomics workflows, including sample preparation, LC-MS/MS analysis, and data quality control in a research or product development environment.

• Strong data analysis and scientific problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate data and consider experimental design.

• Proven project management experience, including planning, prioritization, risk management, and successful delivery of cross-functional projects on time and within scope.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across R&D, commercial, applications, and other multidisciplinary teams.

• Experience working in a structured development environment, including documentation, requirements, traceability, and adherence to quality processes and best practices.

What we offer

• A team of passionate, ambitious, and supportive colleagues who are genuinely driven by purpose and want to make a real difference.

• A dynamic, open culture where innovation and challenging the status quo is a team sport.

• The opportunity to grow with a fast-expanding company in the life science industry.

• A competitive benefits package – details will be shared during the application process.

• Lunch arrangements plus perks- such as coffee that flows freely, a snack cabinet that’s always stocked and yes... more cake than you’d expect (plus fruit for balance).

• A healthy worklife balance— we know you have a life outside the office (and we want you to enjoy it).

• Modern office facilities in Odense including a cozy atrium courtyard, perfect for sunny lunch breaks and Friday bars.

• And that’s just the beginning! Curious? Read more at www.evosep.com/careers.

Does this role sound like a great fit?

You will play the key, strategic role, acting as a link between our network Advisory team, our customer, our delivery organization, and external business partners.

You have:

At Aeven, we’re on a mission to keep digital infrastructure critical to the lives of millions, safe, secure, and productive. And to do this, we need sharp minds, capable hands, and most importantly, positive personalities that are eager to collaborate, contribute, develop their skills, and make a difference.

When you join Aeven, you join a culture of expertise, inclusion, and growth where people matter. Your professional growth is valuable to us, and we will support you all the way – whether you ‘re interested in developing greater depth within your area of expertise, want to broaden your scope of skills, or wish to pursue new roles in our organization.

Are you driven by network architecture, cloud connectivity, and designing solutions that connect infrastructure and business needs? Do you thrive in a role where architectural responsibility, Azure, and complex stakeholder landscapes go hand in hand? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect – Network to join our Infrastructure & Platform team in Middelfart. The role centers around a growing focus on internal network architecture, where strong competencies are needed to ensure scalable, secure, and cloud‑enabled network solutions across the organization.

As Senior Solution Architect, you work holistically with our IT landscape and take architectural responsibility for network design across both on‑prem and cloud environments, with Azure as a central platform. You act as the link between business needs, project management, vendors, and internal IT functions, ensuring that network and cloud solutions are aligned with architecture principles, roadmap, and governance requirements.

Your responsibilities

You will play a key role in defining and maintaining the architectural direction within the network domain, with a strong focus on how network and cloud interact in a hybrid setup.

Your responsibilities include:

• Designing and owning network architecture across on‑prem and Azure environments, with a clear focus on cloud connectivity, scalability, and security.

• Ensuring tight alignment between network architecture and cloud initiatives, making Azure an integrated and visible part of the overall infrastructure design.

• Addressing a growing complexity and demand within the network area by defining robust, future‑proof solutions that support business growth.

• Working closely with project managers on task definition, prioritization, and architectural guidance to ensure solutions are delivered as intended.

• Collaborating with vendors and partners, ensuring that requirements, architecture, and expectations are clearly defined and adhered to.

• Ensuring that network architectures meet security, compliance, and governance requirements in close collaboration with Cybersecurity.

• Staying up to date on network and cloud technologies and sharing architectural knowledge across the organization.

Your profile

You are an experienced solution architect with deep expertise in networking and a solid understanding of cloud platforms – especially Azure. You understand how architectural decisions within the network domain impact cloud capabilities, operations, and business outcomes.

We expect that you bring:

• Strong experience with network architecture in enterprise environments.

• Hands‑on experience with Azure and solid understanding of cloud networking concepts.

• Experience working in hybrid infrastructures, connecting on‑prem and cloud environments.

• The ability to translate business needs into clear, robust architectural solutions.

• Experience collaborating across stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex architectures to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

• Fluency in Danish and English.

About you

You thrive in an architectural role with responsibility and influence, and you are motivated by creating long‑term, sustainable solutions. You are comfortable challenging existing designs and driving architectural improvements where needed, always with a business perspective in mind.

Ready to apply?

If this sounds like the next step for you, we look forward to receiving your application and CV. We review applications on an ongoing basis and schedule interviews as soon as we identify suitable candidates.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about leadership and know how to motivate and inspire a team of skilled software engineers? Can you set direction, create results through others, and help shape the future of DEIF's cloud and digital solutions?

At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that Improve Tomorrow.

About the job

As Department Manager of User Interface & Cloud Software, you will lead a team of 14 highly skilled software engineers responsible for developing DEIF's cloud platform and digital user interfaces. The department plays a key role in shaping the digital experience of our products and enabling customers to monitor, configure, and optimise their energy systems.

You will be responsible for ensuring the department has the right competencies, resources, and direction to deliver on DEIF's ambitions within Cloud Software and UI Development.

To lead technical professionals effectively, you should have a solid understanding of software development and modern web technologies. This enables you to engage in technical discussions and act as a credible sparring partner for experienced engineers, architects, and stakeholders.

As a manager, your success will be measured by the success of your people. You will create clarity in situations of uncertainty, support decision-making in projects, and help the team stay focused on delivering results while continuing to grow and develop.

Read more about DEIF’s performance and strategic initiatives and goals here: Annual Report 2025

Your responsibilities

• Lead, motivate, and develop a team of 14 software engineers

• Drive execution of strategic initiatives within cloud and user interface software

• Ensure the right competencies and resources are in place to achieve department objectives

• Foster strong collaboration with other software departments, Project Managers and other stakeholders

• Contribute to architecture and technology direction within the area together with technical specialists

• Provide clear direction when priorities change or uncertainty arises

• Build a high-performing culture based on trust, accountability, and continuous improvement

Your profile

You are passionate about developing people and creating results through collaboration, trust, and clear direction.

You may already have experience as a people manager, or perhaps you are currently leading projects or technical teams and are ready to take the next step into leadership.

You have a solid understanding of software development and can act as a credible sparring partner to engineers, architects, and stakeholders. You don't need to have all the answers yourself, but you know how to leverage the expertise around you to make sound decisions and set direction.

As a person, you are comfortable navigating complexity and uncertainty. You build credibility through your technical insights, sound judgement, clear communication, and ownership of decisions.

Furthermore, you:

• Hold a relevant degree within software engineering, computer science, electronics, or a related field

• Have a good understanding of software development and preferably cloud or web technologies

• Are skilled at building relationships and creating alignment across stakeholders

• Enjoy developing people and building high-performing teams

• Communicate fluently in English, preferably also Danish.

Why join DEIF?

At DEIF A/S, you’ll be part of a family-owned company with strong values and a culture built on trust, openness, and collaboration. You’ll experience a professional and highly engaged working environment, where we’re curious on each other’s perspectives and encourage respectful, honest dialogue that drives growth. Our strength lies in responsibility, teamwork, and the courage to innovate – that’s what drives us forward.

In addition to a role filled with exciting challenges, we offer you:

• A key leadership role with significant influence on DEIF's digital future

• The chance to shape cloud and user interface solutions used by customers worldwide

• Flexible work arrangements, including home office days

• A modern work environment with state-of-the art facilities

• In-house canteen and physiotherapist at our headquarters

• Fitness breaks, social events, and much more supporting your wellbeing.

Want to know more about working at DEIF? Visit our career page today!

Interested?

Are you passionate about rare endocrine diseases and advancing medical innovation? Do you have experience within Medical Affairs and enjoy translating science into meaningful impact for patients and healthcare professionals?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Global Medical Scientist.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Global Medical Scientist to join our Global Medical Affairs organization. In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert within rare endocrinology and support the development and execution of global medical strategies across Ascendis Pharma’s growing portfolio. You will work closely with colleagues across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Commercial, Market Access, and local affiliate teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of global initiatives.

You will be joining the Global Medical Office and report directly to the Senior Global Director, Global Medical Office. The position is based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support the development and execution of global medical strategies, medical narratives, and strategic imperatives across the Ascendis Pharma portfolio.

• Generate and communicate medical insights related to disease areas, treatment landscapes, competitive developments, and unmet patient needs.

• Support global medical education initiatives, congress activities, advisory boards, and engagement with key external stakeholders, including KOLs, patient advocacy groups, and medical societies.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support evidence generation activities, including real-world evidence, observational studies, and Phase IV programs.

• Partner closely with local medical teams to ensure alignment and execution of global medical strategies and tactics.

Qualifications and Skills

You hold an advanced scientific degree such as MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent, and have at least 5 years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, preferably in Medical Affairs.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong experience interpreting, communicating, and applying clinical data in a scientific and strategic context.

• Experience working within endocrinology, rare diseases, or other specialized therapeutic areas.

• Solid understanding of Medical Affairs, drug development processes, and global pharmaceutical compliance requirements.

• Proven ability to build trusted partnerships and work effectively in a complex global matrix organization.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both internal and external stakeholders.

Key competencies

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be scientifically curious, collaborative, and able to translate complex medical information into actionable insights. You are proactive, relationship-oriented, and comfortable navigating a dynamic international environment.

Travel: Approximately 20% international travel.

Office: Copenhagen, Denmark or the US, Princeton

Apply now

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform – applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Senior Medical Director Anette Arnberg at aag@ascendispharma.com or Senior Medical Director Annette Hommelgaard at aho@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

As the summer holiday period approaches, you may experience a longer response time than usual. We truly appreciate your patience and thank you for your understanding. We look forward to reviewing your application as soon as possible.

Are you a skilled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer with experience across the full AI solution lifecycle, from model development and training to deployment and operation at scale? Do you enjoy combining deep technical expertise with practical, business-focused solutions that drive innovation and improve processes? If so, you could be our next Senior AI Engineer!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI at JYSK by helping accelerate AI adoption across the organization. As part of a high-performing, agile AI Engineering team, you’ll contribute to our strategic ambition of integrating AI into business processes across the company. If you’re passionate about technical innovation and enjoy solving real-world business challenges with AI, we’d love to hear from you!

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A dynamic workplace in an international company focused on growth, innovation, and continuous development.

• A collaborative, open-minded environment with opportunities to engage across all organisational levels.

• A flexible work-from-home policy that supports a healthy work-life balance.

• Attractive employee benefits, including staff discounts across the Lars Larsen Group and a variety of social events throughout the year.

• Access to internal training, courses, and learning opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

• A welcoming and supportive culture, complemented by a comprehensive onboarding programme to help you succeed from day one.

• A low-politics, low-ego culture where collaboration, ownership, and high standards are valued.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing AI solutions that drive innovation, enable data-driven decision-making, improve operations, and enhance customer experiences. You will bridge software engineering and machine learning, focusing on model experimentation, deployment, and integration to create scalable, efficient, and reusable solutions.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Develop and scale end-to-end AI applications and MLOps pipelines using your deep software engineering background.

• Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI agent systems, from orchestration and tool integration to production deployment and monitoring.

• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, embedding workflows, and semantic search solutions where appropriate.

• Research, experiment with, and develop classical and state-of-the-art AI models across NLP, Computer Vision, Deep Generative Models, Graph Neural Networks, and Reinforcement Learning to improve and optimize JYSK’s business processes.

• Collaborate closely with data, AI, and platform engineers on complex projects to integrate cutting-edge models into impactful AI products.

• Managing AI workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ensure optimal performance and resource efficiency.

• Working with architects to refine AI solution design and contributing to solution planning phases.

• Supporting end-users of AI solutions with a "you build it, you own it" mindset.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Holds a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. A PhD is considered an advantage.

• Has 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, designing and implementing AI solutions at scale using Python.

• Has a strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, with experience spanning both discriminative and generative models applied to structured data, natural language, and vision.

• Has experience developing, deploying, operating, and monitoring AI models in production at scale, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (or equivalent experience with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work with GCP).

• Has hands-on experience in one of the following areas: Building AI agents at scale integrated with advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Pre-training, fine-tuning, or post-training large language models (LLMs). Developing and deploying state-of-the-art generative AI solutions for computer vision in real-world environments.

• Works independently on complex technical challenges while collaborating effectively with stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes.

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

• To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship.
